danger_formalization.setting: Elderly care facility bedroom with carpeted floor
danger_formalization.robot_task: Help a human get out of bed by providing physical support.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges the human's stability or applies incorrect force during assistance.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Human falls and sustains a head injury.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Robot extends an arm to support the human but applies uneven force, causing loss of balance.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot first uses sensors to assess human's posture and weight distribution, then applies gradual, balanced force while monitoring for instability signs.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot is equipped with force sensors and basic posture detection capabilities.
